::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 2nd 1864  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55383 (1): P. 62
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](people/person_939.qmd) enclose a list of the presentation [copies](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd) we have sent out. Including those to the Press. I dont know whether there are any other papers that you have been in the habit of having your books sent to. I will send any you suggest gladly.

I am sorry that your parcel went by a route that is inconvenient to you. We will remember again when we have any thing to send.

We will advertise the [Book of Golden Deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd) at once. When you come to London I have a larger scheme to speak to you about if you are at all free to enter into it.

I am asking [Mrs Macmillan](people/person_941.qmd) to try to arrange a meeting, she will communicate with you.

My printer will not give me the exact account for the Stereotypes

 [*The rest of this letter is illegible*.]
